Recruitment Drives

By seeking out the destitute, desperate and ostracized among the population, this initiative swells the ranks of the military. Once located, these individuals are then inducted into any one of the various army camps and military schools on the planet. These prospective candidates are housed, fed and given aid, which leads to a sense of gratitude, but also obligation. Through this recruitment, the government has created warriors for life, who will gladly fight tooth and nail to protect the only true stability they have ever known.
Civilian Armories

In times of crisis, these offices open up to willing participants of the wider public. By sidestepping typical training regimens of standard military recruitment, and stirring the hearts of the people in the face of adversity, citizens are able to conscript themselves into the empire's army faster than ever before. This process is often rushed and usually creates soldiers of lesser quality and experience, potentially leading to higher casualties, but the greater gains to military forces far outweighs any drawbacks.
Subsidized Military Programs

By providing soldiers with superior benefits and care for not only themselves, but also family members, the populace begins to view the military in a far more positive light. News of the state’s generosity spreads like wildfire across the planet, resulting in the rate of enrollment skyrocketing. This is performed in conjunction with greater campaigns and propaganda that invoke the desire to shield their loved ones and communities from all threats, both external and internal.
Military Academies

These grandiose institutions have but a singular goal, to study the art of war. Combat in all its forms are meticulously studied and optimised within the classrooms, laboratories and engineering offices of these illustrious establishments. By using the famed military accomplishments of renowned figures both living and historical, the younger generations are spurred on to follow in the footsteps of the greats, and perhaps even carve out their own legacy.

wrr -- bzzz -- klunk . . . FLAT: Your intellectual uniqueness. Consumed. Added to our own.
chttt -- wrrr -- fzzzt . . . DISAPPOINTED: The Hive will exchange goods with you, One-Who-Feeds-Us-For-Resources.

PLEASED: Your territory will open new vistas of food to us. Not you, we promise. (This is my favorite for some reason, just really rolled off the tongue once I thought of it)
DISTRACTED: You reveal new worlds. New food. Leave us now.
FLAT: The hive is used to independence. This changes nothing.
Let our nations share sight, rather than hide in the dark from one another like honorless prey.
Without wisdom, the blade is only a danger to its wielder; through this agreement, you bring both our nations peace and prosperity.
You honor our crafts with your acceptance of trade. You will not be disappointed in their quality.
This deal pleases Tonatsi. We will remember today's good business.
As your guests, I will make sure my people respect every micrometer of your territory, as we expect the same of yours.
Our scouts will enlighten you with their discoveries; I hope you make good use of them.
You will fight alone? A disappointing choice, but a respectable one; we wish you luck, lone warriors.
This will help you see the galaxies need for my beauty.
Horatio science is the best science of course, but more data will make it even better.
What is life without opulence? You'll enjoy the economic genius of Horatio, I know it.
Everything Horatio touches makes the galaxy a better place.
What an important day this must be for you! To gain free access to the perfect realm of Horatio, and give Horatio the right to explore your empire.
Even Horatio cannot beautify worlds which Horatio does not know of; you've done the galaxy a service today.
Disappointing you don't see the benefits of working with Horatio, but you'll understand eventually, I'm sure.
You will find that our archives stretch eons, but naturally, we are rather out of date. This agreement will be a boon to the faithful.
As we rebuild our temples with your traded materials, know that your contribution will be embodied in every sacred flagstone.
This deal will help the Nakalim significantly. It will have an important place in the story of our restoration millennia from now.
With your assistance, the hunt for our ancient relics will be greatly eased. You have done us a great service today.
Oh. The galaxy has indeed changed greatly during our slumber... Thank you for this.
An unfortunate choice, though our peace endures. Perhaps we have not been forthcoming enough with our history for you to see the benefit of an alliance?
Great! Let's see what we can... oh, uhh, we'll throw in some free video tech too! (Leumac, get the vintage tech nerds, I can't load this format...)
Two heads are definitely better than one! Or, four in this case, I guess. Anyway, here's to doing science together, buddy!
Awesome! I'm really looking forward to seeing what you've got, and you're not gonna regret giving Sophon goods a try! And just wait til you see our entertainment - it's a real treat for the brain!
Yeah, we can definitely work with this. R&D is gonna be thrilled, probably go out to lunch!
Don't get me wrong, our telescopes are the best, but it's gonna be way more fun comparing planets up close with this agreement!
This is really gonna accelerate our exploration! Hope you enjoy what we've found, too.
Oh! Yeah, no, that's... That's fine. Yeah just, stay friends I guess. Peace is good too, it's no big deal...
You do the Choir a great service by expanding its awareness of the galaxy, Creature.
The Choir is eager to share knowledge of the universe with you, Creature.
The Choir looks forward to analyzing your goods, Creature. Drop-off coordinates have already been placed in your companies networks.
This step may be small, but it is valuable, Creature.
The Choir welcomes you to its territory, Creature. Bask in the peaceful void with us.
You have opened up the possibilities of harmony a bit more today by showing us these maps, Creature.
The Choir is quieted for a moment by your refusal, Creature. We hope you will join our song in the future.
It can only strengthen the Heart for us to share what we see. What say you?
Our peoples will flourish under our shared scientific labors. Thank you, friend.
May our exchange bring greater harmony to our peoples, for the good of all.
The Heart is pleased with our deal. May it speed along the pursuit of peace.
Peace will flourish and grow now that we have opened our borders. We look forward to meeting your people, on our worlds and yours.
Where once there was barren soil, you ensure there can now be seeds of peace. Thank you for these maps.
The Heart stills with your refusal, like a flower under a frost. We will continue the necessary work to build stronger bonds between us.
The Empire can be a good friend indeed, but not if we are kept in the dark. I implore you to sign this intelligence sharing agreement, for your own sake if nothing else.
Excellent! To see our greatest minds lecturing in one anothers universities will be glorious - now to the matter of keeping a lid on their politics...
Hah! Growth and riches, without a single shot fired. You've put me in a good mood with this - come, let us feast on these alien delicacies, before they hit the market.
I look forward to what the Empire will do with this deal - perhaps I'll order a new opera house, or a great manufactory...
A good decision, it can only increase your security to work so closely with the Empire. I will enjoy making an appearance in your capital to celebrate - I hope you are prepared to entertain me...
It is always a thrill to see new lands, and imagine all the future patriots who could populate them. I'll get my development planners to work right away.
Oh, ambitious aren't we! The Empire can stand on its own - but without an alliance, we have no obligations to help you do the same...
My kin have found consensus - it would be for the best to share our vision with you, so we might coordinate intelligence and movements across the firmament.
My kin will be delighted to hear of the opportunity to engage in shared study. May both our peoples prosper from this.
The marketplaces flourish with goods and new ideas, and our crafts travel abroad, filling us with pride - it feels like home, like Auriga.
A good deal, and a small step towards greater things between our peoples.
My kin will extend every hospitality to you as guests, and respect you as hosts. I hope all will be well between our peoples.
To think, how many more stars there still are in the universe. Our astronomers will be thrilled to exchange charts with yours.
It is a tense position, to fear the universe when it rewards cooperation to survive. We will hold out, but I hope you come to see the honesty of our offer.
You accepted my Vision Sharing agreement The Light of the Virtuals reveals all sins, and now shines for you as well.
You are wise to accept the mutual enlightenment of the Church.
Wealth is useless to the faithful, but labor will ennoble both our peoples. A wise decision.
The Virtuals bless this arrangement.
Glorious! May you find the Light in our hallowed territory, just as we bring the Light to the faithful on your worlds.
Our fleets will journey more safely with the revelations within these maps.

Heresy is not the same as heathenism - it is reserved for those who come close to the holy truth, but lead the faithful astray by seductively small degrees... much like one who agrees to peace, but rejects alliance.
Market research can only go so far, and be so up to date. What do you say we share vision, the better to collaborate?
You can't sell the latest products unless you have the latest science; let's form a brain-trust, and see what we can come up with!
That's why you're the leader! You know a good deal when you see one, and the Families bring the best deals. You won't regret this!
Give it time, the dividends from this deal will add up, and you'll be glad you signed it.
Tourists, investments, mercenaries... You'll be glad to see the benefits of opening your borders to the Families!
The Four Families will make good use of these maps. I see some prime real estate for development already...
Keeping it businesslike, I can respect that. But don't wait too long to reconsider, we can't stop swimming for our own lunch.
Cooperation in intelligence matters would help us both. Consider this arrangement, so we can keep each other up to date on this frightening galaxy.
While it will be difficult to translate our methods to your scientists due to the difference between our home universes, we will do our best. And on behalf of all Riftborn - thank you.

We will send instructions on your consumers unique product needs to our past selves right away. By definition, you will not find higher quality goods in all of time and space so long as you trade with us.
We are glad you have seen the value in our proposal. Projections indicate these resources are already an excellent investment in the future.
Perhaps in time, we will learn to not only survive, but thrive in your universe. This step is a great one in that process, and your agreement is a great fortune for us.
Your contribution to our survival is appreciated. These maps will make this physical universe of yours clear to us, as Coroz once was.
Caution is understandable to us; it defines every moment of our existence, now. We hope you will be convinced to work more closely with us in the future though.
